interview.secured: Day secured means you've completed all your tasks for that day and earned your streak.
interview.freeze: A freeze holds your streak if you miss a day, so you don't lose your progress.
interview.selfReported: Self-reported means you manually log that you completed the task instead of the app automatically tracking it with your camera.
interview.tomorrow: 9 - I like the strict accountability with photo verification, and the streak system keeps me motivated to show up.

goals.text: Pick a fitness challenge, choose Strict if the app offers it, and finish today's task with a photo.
